keep_with_rename.why: owner 2026-09-04: 'beamcasting is a weapon tech? We might want to keep that then.' The MechDisruptor weapon stands; the mech-command helm/booster halves go dead with mechanitors out — rewrite scope for later.

design_rationale.The Hearth: was 23/21/3/0/0 — a wall of cheap comfort. Now climbs: campfire floor (T0) -> crafted comfort and dress (T1) -> powered/modern living (T2) -> luxury (T3). Each tier purchase visibly upgrades daily life.
design_rationale.The Unbolting: was 0/3/17/5/2 with every droid at T2 — one purchase bought the whole robot age. Now a liberation ladder: humble workers (T1) -> civilian specialists (T2) -> military and advanced parts (T3) -> legends (T4).
design_rationale.The Waking Mind: was 6 rows stacked at T4. The AI ladder now climbs steadily; the c=500 comms/warcasket kit spreads T1-T3 instead of squatting at the top.
design_rationale.Powder & Slug: top of the tree was empty (T3:2, T4:0) — nothing to aspire to. Heaviest ordnance now caps the tree.
design_rationale.The Foundry Hive: 4 rows, two tiers. Now one per tier T1-T4 with sonic weaponry as the tree's T4 signature prize.
design_rationale.untouched: Scavenger (owner's exemplar), The Refinery, The Workshop, Blasterworks, The Strange Schools, The Shell, THE SHIP (endgame top-heavy is right), The Reach, The Junker Yards, The Ascendant Ladder (already spread 3/2/2/1).
